name: Ascendant
description: The same run read upward: short at the top, full height at the foot.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 20%; bottom: 0; width: 60%; height: @calc(16 + 84 * @y / @Y)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-radius: 999px 999px 0 0; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
